scope: OpenFormula expression syntax, Part4 chapter5; no evaluation or name/source resolution

requirements.requirement: Optional equals and forced-recalculation marker; complete expression; preserved original spelling.
Strict number grammar including leading-decimal form and signed exponent; numeric lexemes do not require conversion to finite f64.
Double-quoted strings with doubled quotes; NUL excluded.
All operators, exact precedence, left-associative exponentiation and comparisons, right-associative prefix signs.
XML Letter/Digit/CombiningChar function names; immediate opening parenthesis; semicolon parameters with empty slots; host functions remain inert.
Existing bounded references plus infix range/intersection/union operators.
Quoted labels and automatic label intersection syntax; no lookup.
Simple, sheet-local and external named-expression syntax with inert validated source IRIs.
Constant error lexical grammar, retaining specific spelling.
Inline array expressions with nonempty rows/cells, semicolon columns and vertical-bar rows; retain ragged row syntax without asserting evaluability.
Only SPACE, TAB, LF, CR lexical whitespace; preserve original source and reject whitespace splitting terminal grammar rules.
Format-owned ergonomic inspection; bounded fallible allocation and parsing depth; flat ownership avoids recursive destruction; no ambient execution/I/O.
